**3. Satu hal yang TIDAK otomatis ikut pindah**



Bagian "Langkah 2 — Setting Zed" di playbook (`tool_permissions` di `settings.json`) itu spesifik Zed. Antigravity punya mekanisme sendiri untuk auto-approve/agent-mode (biasanya ada toggle semacam "auto-accept edits" atau level otonomi agent) — cek dulu itu di pengaturan Antigravity supaya agent tidak berhenti minta izin di tiap langkah pas mode otonom jalan.

```

Kamu sekarang beroperasi dalam MODE OTONOM untuk melanjutkan migrasi Zenith,

menggantikan sesi Zed sebelumnya yang kehabisan kredit.

tepat setelah menemukan text-starchart/50 gagal AA, sebelum commit).



Gunakan skill `a11y-auditor` untuk menyelesaikan sisa audit kontras Fase 5.

Aturan yang sudah ditetapkan (tidak perlu dihitung ulang per instance):

kombinasi warna yang lolos AA large-text (>=3:1) tapi gagal AA normal-text

(<4.5:1) HANYA perlu diperbaiki (naikkan ke /80 atau solid) kalau dipakai di

teks berukuran normal/kecil (<24px, atau <19px kalau bold) — untuk

heading/label besar, biarkan apa adanya.



Setelah Fase 5 selesai, lanjutkan Fase 6 (gunakan skill relevan seperti

dan Fase 7 (QA checklist), sesuai isi lengkap §5 dan kondisi otonom di §7

ZENITH_PLAYBOOK.md. Semua keputusan desain/brand/hosting sudah final di

bagian 0.1 dokumen itu — jangan tanya ulang.



Commit tiap fase, update PROGRESS.md, dan STOP hanya di kondisi yang sudah

240: ## Small decisions made along the way (not pre-specified in §0.1)

241: 

242: - Reused `https://github.com/Zxaviers/zenith.git` (no `-portfolio` suffix)

243:   since the name was available.

244: - Keeping Vite's existing npm scripts as the "live" ones until Next.js is

245:   proven out, adding parallel `*:next` scripts instead of overwriting —

246:   most reversible option, avoids any window where `npm run dev`/`build`

247:   breaks for whoever might deploy from this branch mid-migration.

248: - **Renamed `src/pages/` → `src/views/`** (and updated the 5 imports in

249:   `src/App.jsx`). Root cause: Next.js auto-detects `src/pages` as a Pages

250:   Router directory whenever a `src/` folder exists at the project root,

251:   regardless of intent — it doesn't require a `src/app` sibling to trigger

252:   that check. With our new root-level `app/` *and* the old `src/pages`,

253:   Next enabled both routers simultaneously and tried to webpack-bundle the

254:   Vite pages' `*.test.jsx` files (which import `vitest`), causing a hard

255:   build failure (`node:module` unhandled scheme error via

256:   `vite/dist/node/module-runner.js`). Renaming avoids the collision

257:   entirely. This does touch Vite source, but only a folder name + import

258:   paths — Vite/React Router attach no special meaning to a folder named

259:   "pages", so there's no behavior change, confirmed by `npm run build` and

260:   `npm run test` both still passing after the rename. Considered safer

261:   than trying to suppress Next's directory auto-detection, which isn't

262:   configurable.

263: - Used `next.config.mjs` instead of `next.config.ts`: the `.ts` config

264:   variant failed to load (`Cannot read properties of undefined (reading

265:   'fileExists')` from Next's internal TS transpilation), a known class of

266:   issue unrelated to our code. Switching to plain `.mjs` sidesteps it

267:   entirely and we don't need TS-specific config typing yet.

268: - Added `outputFileTracingRoot` pinned to the project directory in

269:   `next.config.mjs`, because Next.js was misdetecting the workspace root

270:   due to an unrelated stray `package-lock.json` in the user's home

271:   directory (outside this repo). Harmless either way, but keeps file

272:   tracing correctly scoped.

273: - Set `eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds: true` in `next.config.mjs` for now —

274:   the existing `eslint.config.js` is a Vite-oriented flat config without

275:   the `next/core-web-vitals` plugin; wiring a proper combined ESLint setup

276:   is deferred to a later phase rather than blocking the Fase 1 build.

277: - Pinned `typescript@^5` explicitly as a devDependency after `npm install`

278:   initially pulled in a TypeScript 7 prerelease that Next.js 15 doesn't

279:   support yet ("TypeScript 7.0.2 is not supported by this version of

280:   Next.js").

281: - Note for later: `create_directory` and `copy_path` tools were both

282:   non-functional in this environment for this repo (consistently returned

283:   "outside the project" / similar errors even for root-level test paths);

284:   worked around using `write_file` (which creates the file but not missing

285:   parent dirs) plus plain shell `mkdir -p`/`mv` via the terminal tool.

286: - **Tokens via CSS `@theme`, not `tailwind.config.ts`.** The playbook's

287:   wording ("tambahkan ke tailwind.config.ts") assumes Tailwind v3-style JS

288:   config, but this project is already on Tailwind v4

289:   (`@tailwindcss/postcss`, `@import 'tailwindcss'` in CSS — set up before

290:   this rework started). v4's idiomatic, first-class way to extend the

291:   theme is a CSS `@theme {}` block, which is what generates the utility

292:   classes directly (confirmed `bg-comet`, `text-void`, etc. in the

293:   compiled output). A `tailwind.config.ts` would have been redundant/inert

294:   for this purpose under v4, so skipped it rather than add a file that

295:   does nothing.

296: - **`next/font/google` instead of `next/font/local`** for Press Start 2P /

297:   Nunito / VT323. Both approaches self-host (no runtime request to

298:   Google's CDN, which is the actual goal behind the playbook's wording);

299:   `next/font/local` would additionally require sourcing and committing the

300:   actual `.woff2` files ourselves with correct licensing, which is extra

301:   manual work for the same runtime outcome. Reversible later if we ever

302:   need fully offline builds or a font not on Google Fonts.

1: # 🗺️ Zenith Rework — Master Playbook untuk Zed Agent
2: 
3: > Peran saya di sini: **mind master** yang menyusun brief + prompt. Eksekusi teknis (edit file, install package, commit) dilakukan oleh Agent Panel di Zed. Tempel tiap blok "PROMPT UNTUK ZED" secara berurutan, review diff-nya, baru lanjut ke fase berikutnya — jangan tempel semua sekaligus, karena migrasi Vite→Next.js + rebranding + reskin sekaligus terlalu besar untuk satu pass agent yang reliable.
4: 
5: **Catatan soal daftar skill yang kamu lampirkan:** itu terbaca seperti katalog skill gaya *Google Antigravity*, bukan sistem skill Zed. Zed Agent tidak "memanggil" skill dengan nama seperti itu — dia hanya membaca instruksi di prompt/context yang kamu berikan. Jadi saya sudah **menenun keahlian dari skill-skill yang relevan langsung ke dalam prompt di bawah**, supaya tetap jalan di Zed tanpa bergantung pada sistem skill itu. Kalau ternyata kamu *juga* punya skill/rules file custom di dalam project untuk Zed (`.rules`, `AGENTS.md`, dst), sebut nama skill relevan (`claude-frontend-design`, `impeccable`, `framer-motion-expert`, `a11y-auditor`, `stitch-google`, `react-performance-optimizer`, `vercel-v0`) di awal prompt supaya agent Zed ikut membacanya sebagai konteks tambahan.

9: ## 0. Temuan Audit Cepat
10: 
11: Saya cek repo dan situs live-nya dulu sebelum menulis brief:
12: 
13: - Repo `Zxaviers/Zxaviers` bukan cuma profile-README — isinya juga source code situs: `src/`, `public/`, `vite.config.js`, `tailwind.config.js`, `postcss.config.js`, `eslint.config.js`, `.prettierrc`, `.github/workflows`. Artinya stack saat ini **Vite + React + Tailwind**, dideploy lewat GitHub Actions (kemungkinan besar ke GitHub Pages).
14: - ⚠️ **Perhatian penting**: nama repo `Zxaviers/Zxaviers` (sama dengan username) itu repo spesial GitHub — isinya otomatis tampil di halaman profil `github.com/Zxaviers`. Kalau kamu rebrand ke Zenith dan ganti nama repo, kamu **kehilangan fitur profile-README otomatis** itu. Rekomendasi: buat repo baru khusus situs, misal `zenith` atau `zenith-portfolio`, dan biarkan `Zxaviers/Zxaviers` tetap jadi profile README (atau update juga kontennya belakangan, terpisah dari kode situs).
15: - Situs live saat ini: *"Zxaviers | Computer Engineering Student & Web Developer"* — portfolio Rizky Mardhani, fokus web dev + IoT/embedded (ESP32, Arduino, sensor).
16: - Codedex.io: brand identitasnya adalah "coding sebagai petualangan fantasi" — pixel art, XP, region yang di-unlock, badge koleksi. Ini yang jadi acuan *vibe*, bukan untuk ditiru palet warnanya mentah-mentah (biar Zenith tidak terasa seperti clone).

21: 3. Domain: tetap pakai `zxaviers.site` dulu. ✅ dikonfirmasi.
22: 4. ~~Hosting: Vercel.~~ ❌ **salah** — audit menemukan situs live di **Netlify** (`public/_redirects`, mention eksplisit di kode). Lihat 0.1.

24: ## 0.1 Keputusan setelah audit Fase 0 (berdasarkan laporanmu)
25: 
26: | Pertanyaan terbuka dari audit | Keputusan |
27: |---|---|
28: | Hosting target? | **Netlify** (bukan Vercel/GitHub Pages). Pakai `@netlify/plugin-nextjs` — support penuh App Router, SSR, ISR, image optimization, dynamic OG image. Tidak perlu static export. |
29: | Repo yang sama atau split? | **Split.** Buat repo baru `zenith`, push branch kerja ke sana. `Zxaviers/Zxaviers` dibiarkan utuh sebagai profile README GitHub. Detail eksekusi di Fase 0.5. |
30: | Devlog & SecretGame easter egg? | **Dipertahankan keduanya.** Selaras dengan brief "hangat & playful", bukan penyimpangan. SecretGame boleh dikuatkan jadi easter egg tersembunyi di starfield (nice-to-have). |
31: | Garis personal vs brand? | Handle GitHub/Instagram/email = identitas personal, **tidak berubah**. Wordmark/judul/heading/OG image = brand proyek, **jadi "Zenith"**. Dialog `About.jsx` dipertahankan formatnya, tapi framing-nya: Zxaviers = operator/pilot, Zenith = nama misi. |
32: | Domain? | Tetap `zxaviers.site` untuk sekarang. |
33: 
34: Konsekuensi: **ini evolusi, bukan rebuild dari nol.** `Skills.jsx` (grid skill grouped), `Experience.jsx` ("AGENT STATUS", heading "Mission Log"), `About.jsx` (dialog Headquarters↔Zxaviers), dan starfield/pixel-panel CSS yang sudah ada jadi **basis** untuk Fase 4, bukan dibuang dan ditulis ulang dari nol.

39:

45: | `framer-motion-expert` | Semua micro-interaction bergaya game (hover sprite, path reveal, boot sequence). |
46: | `a11y-auditor` | Wajib — palet gelap + font pixel rawan masalah kontras & keterbacaan. |
47: | `react-performance-optimizer` | Next.js tetap React di baliknya; jaga performa walau banyak aset pixel/animasi. |
48: | `accidental-data-loss-prevention` | Aktifkan saja sebagai jaring pengaman selama migrasi (banyak file lama akan dihapus/diganti). |

50: ## 2. Skill tambahan yang saya rekomendasikan kamu tambahkan
51: 
52: Tidak ada di daftarmu yang secara spesifik menutup area berikut. Kalau sistem skill-mu (Antigravity atau lainnya) bisa install skill baru, ini yang paling bernilai untuk project ini — urut prioritas:
53: 
54: 1. **Next.js App Router / Server Components specialist** — migrasi Vite→Next.js punya jebakan spesifik (routing, metadata API, `next/image`, client vs server component) yang tidak dicover skill React generik.
55: 2. **Pixel-art & retro game UI specialist** — soal teknis 9-slice panel, sprite sheet, `image-rendering: pixelated`, grid pixel-perfect scaling — beda kelas dari desain frontend biasa.
56: 3. **Technical SEO / Core Web Vitals auditor** — penting karena kamu ganti brand + kemungkinan struktur URL; perlu sitemap, structured data, dan Lighthouse budget yang dijaga ketat.
57: 4. **Game-narrative copywriting** — supaya copy "quest/adventure" tidak terasa cringe atau template; ini beda skill dari desain visual.
58: 
59: Kalau tidak ada skill siap pakai untuk keempat ini, tidak masalah — instruksinya sudah saya tulis langsung di dalam prompt Fase 3–6 di bawah, jadi Zed Agent tetap bisa jalan.

63: ## 3. Design Brief — "Zenith: Warm Nebula" (tema space, dipertahankan dari identitas asli)
64: 
65: Kamu benar, saya koreksi: identitas asli Zxaviers memang **space-themed** ("Pixel-art & Space-themed UI lover", "Powered by Pixel Art & Space Vibes 🚀") — itu harus dipertahankan, bukan diganti tema gunung. Kabar baiknya, ini malah lebih pas: secara astronomi **"zenith"** adalah titik tertinggi di langit tepat di atas pengamat — jadi nama brand dan tema space nyambung secara alami, tanpa harus meniru "desa fantasi" ala Codedex. Yang saya ambil dari Codedex cuma *vibe*-nya: hangat, santai, pixel, terasa seperti sedang berpetualang — bukan palet warnanya.
66: 
67: ### Token warna — "Warm Nebula"
68: | Nama | Hex | Peran |
69: |---|---|---|
70: | Comet Orange | `#FF8B4C` | Aksen utama, CTA, ekor komet/api roket |
71: | Star Gold | `#FFC857` | Aksen sekunder, badge/XP/glow bintang |
72: | Void Indigo | `#1B1235` | Background dasar (ruang angkasa gelap) |
73: | Nebula Violet | `#3E2A63` | Layer kartu/panel — awan nebula di atas background |
74: | Star Chart Cream | `#F5E9D6` | Teks terang & panel gaya "peta bintang" kertas astronom lama |
75: | Aurora Green | `#6FCF97` | Status sukses/"level up", dipakai sangat sedikit |
76: 
77: *(Ini tetap palet gelap-hangat dengan aksen oranye-emas yang sama seperti sebelumnya — cuma pemaknaannya sekarang eksplisit ruang angkasa: nebula, komet, bintang, aurora — bukan gunung/senja.)*
78: 
79: ### Tipografi
80: - **Display/pixel** (dipakai terbatas — judul hero, label section, badge): `Press Start 2P` atau `Silkscreen`, self-hosted via `next/font/local`.
81: - **Body** (untuk keterbacaan panjang): sans hangat dan rounded — `Nunito` atau `Quicksand`, bukan pixel font, supaya paragraf tetap nyaman dibaca.
82: - **Angka/stat/tag** (Lv., XP, tech-tag): monospace ringan — `JetBrains Mono` atau `VT323` — dipakai kecil saja untuk sentuhan game tanpa merusak keterbacaan.
83: 
84: ### Layout & signature element
85: - Section bukan navbar biasa, tapi **peta bintang/navigasi (star map)**: About = *Mission Control*, Skills = *Constellation*, Projects = *Mission Log*, Experience = *Flight Path*, Contact = *Send a Transmission*. Titik-titik bintang terhubung garis putus pixel yang "tergambar" saat discroll, seperti menghubungkan rasi bintang.
86: - **Elemen signature (satu-satunya yang paling berani, sisanya tenang)**: **Constellation Skill Tree** di section Skills — tiap skill jadi bintang pixel, dikelompokkan per kategori (Web, IoT/Embedded, Tools) membentuk rasi bintang yang saling terhubung, hover/tap menampilkan tooltip "Lv." dan bintangnya menyala lebih terang. Ini menjawab "petualangan interaktif" secara nyata sekaligus tetap 100% tema space.
87: - Kartu bergaya panel HUD kokpit / peta bintang astronom: border pixel 9-slice, sudut bertakik gaya cockpit display, drop shadow keras (offset, bukan blur) — bukan `shadow-xl` blur khas Tailwind default.
88: - Hero: parallax starfield multi-layer (bintang dekat bergerak cepat, nebula jauh bergerak lambat saat scroll/mouse-move) + sprite kecil astronaut/roket pixel dengan idle-bob animation, tombol CTA bergaya tombol "launch" konsol (turun 2px + shadow snap saat diklik).
89: - Motion dipakai secukupnya: boot-sequence loading singkat bergaya "ignition/launch countdown" (±1 detik, auto-skip jika `prefers-reduced-motion`), reveal jalur rasi bintang saat scroll, idle-sprite animation di hero. Hindari animasi bertebaran di semua elemen — itu yang membuat desain terasa AI-generated.

117: ## 5. Prompt Siap Pakai untuk Zed Agent
118: 
119: Tempel satu blok per fase. Setelah tiap fase selesai, **review diff, jalankan `pnpm dev`/`npm run dev`, commit**, baru lanjut fase berikutnya.
120: 
121: ### FASE 0 — Audit & Branch
122: 
123: ```
124: Kamu bekerja di repo Zxaviers/Zxaviers (Vite + React + Tailwind), portfolio pribadi.
125: Tugas fase ini HANYA audit, jangan ubah kode dulu:
126: 
127: 1. Buat branch baru: feature/zenith-nextjs-rework
128: 2. Scan seluruh repo (src/, public/, index.html, package.json, README.md,
129:    .github/workflows) dan buat daftar SEMUA kemunculan string "zxaviers",
130:    "Zxaviers", "ZXAVIERS" (case-insensitive) beserta file dan barisnya.
131: 3. Identifikasi semua file/section komponen yang merepresentasikan: Hero,
132:    About, Skills, Projects/Portfolio, Experience/Timeline (jika ada), Contact,
133:    Footer, Navbar.
134: 4. Cek deployment: apakah .github/workflows men-deploy ke GitHub Pages atau
135:    platform lain? Cek base path / homepage di package.json atau vite.config.js.
136: 5. Rangkum semua temuan di atas dalam bentuk checklist markdown
137:    (REBRAND_AUDIT.md di root repo) tapi JANGAN commit dulu — tampilkan isinya
138:    ke saya dulu untuk saya konfirmasi sebelum lanjut ke fase migrasi.
139: ```
140: 
141: ### FASE 0.5 — Split Repo (baru, hasil keputusan pasca-audit)
142: 
143: ```
144: Sebelum scaffold Next.js dimulai, pisahkan kerja ini dari repo profile-README:
145: 
146: 1. Buat repo baru KOSONG di akun yang sama bernama "zenith" (via GitHub CLI
147:    `gh repo create zenith --private --source=. ` atau lewat web lalu tambahkan
148:    sebagai remote — pilih cara yang tersedia).
149: 2. Tambahkan remote baru, misal:
150:    git remote add zenith-origin git@github.com:<username>/zenith.git
151: 3. Push branch feature/zenith-nextjs-rework saat ini ke remote baru sebagai
152:    main-nya:
153:    git push zenith-origin feature/zenith-nextjs-rework:main
154: 4. Konfirmasikan ke saya bahwa repo baru sudah berisi branch ini sebagai main,
155:    lalu SEMUA fase berikutnya (Fase 1 dst) dikerjakan dengan remote origin
156:    diarahkan ke repo "zenith" ini, BUKAN lagi ke Zxaviers/Zxaviers.
157: 5. JANGAN hapus, force-push, atau ubah apa pun di remote asli Zxaviers/Zxaviers
158:    — repo itu tetap harus berfungsi sebagai profile README GitHub tanpa
159:    terganggu oleh migrasi ini.
160: ```
161: 
162: ### FASE 1 — Scaffold Next.js baru
163: 
164: ```
165: Konteks penting: ini EVOLUSI dari implementasi yang sudah cukup matang, bukan
166: rebuild dari nol. Sebelum menulis komponen baru, baca dulu implementasi yang
167: sudah ada: Skills.jsx (grid skill grouped web/iot/tools, connector lines,
168: tooltip, level coloring), Experience.jsx ("AGENT STATUS" stat card, heading
169: "Mission Log"), About.jsx (dialog Headquarters↔Zxaviers), starfield background
170: + pixel-panel CSS yang sudah ada, devlog (/devlog), dan SecretGame easter egg
171: tersembunyi. Semua itu DIPERTAHANKAN kontennya, hanya migrasi bentuk teknisnya
172: ke Next.js/TypeScript di fase-fase berikutnya — jangan didesain ulang dari nol.
173: 
174: Sekarang mulai migrasi ke Next.js (di repo "zenith" hasil Fase 0.5):
175: 
176: 1. Inisialisasi Next.js 15 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ESLint)
177:    di dalam repo yang sama (boleh di folder sementara lalu dipindah, atau
178:    langsung di root — pilih pendekatan yang paling minim risiko merusak
179:    file lama sebelum migrasi selesai).
180: 2. Install dependency tambahan: framer-motion, lucide-react, clsx,
181:    tailwind-merge, @netlify/plugin-nextjs.
182: 3. Migrasikan tailwind.config.js ke tailwind.config.ts, sesuaikan content
183:    paths untuk struktur app/.
184: 4. Pindahkan aset dari public/ lama ke public/ Next.js, pertahankan struktur
185:    yang masih relevan, termasuk public/_redirects (sesuaikan isinya nanti
186:    di Fase 6 kalau ada rule yang konflik dengan routing Next.js).
187: 5. Pastikan route /devlog dan trigger SecretGame easter egg tetap dipetakan
188:    di struktur app/ baru — jangan sampai hilang saat migrasi routing.
189: 6. Buat app/layout.tsx dan app/page.tsx kosong yang bisa jalan (npm run dev
190:    tanpa error) sebelum kita isi kontennya di fase berikutnya.
191: 7. Jangan hapus source Vite lama dulu — biarkan koeksis di branch ini sampai
192:    migrasi selesai dan tervalidasi, baru dihapus di fase terakhir.
193: ```

240: ## Small decisions made along the way (not pre-specified in §0.1)

241: 

242: - Reused `https://github.com/Zxaviers/zenith.git` (no `-portfolio` suffix)

243:   since the name was available.

244: - Keeping Vite's existing npm scripts as the "live" ones until Next.js is

245:   proven out, adding parallel `*:next` scripts instead of overwriting —

246:   most reversible option, avoids any window where `npm run dev`/`build`

247:   breaks for whoever might deploy from this branch mid-migration.

248: - **Renamed `src/pages/` → `src/views/`** (and updated the 5 imports in

249:   `src/App.jsx`). Root cause: Next.js auto-detects `src/pages` as a Pages

250:   Router directory whenever a `src/` folder exists at the project root,

251:   regardless of intent — it doesn't require a `src/app` sibling to trigger

252:   that check. With our new root-level `app/` *and* the old `src/pages`,

253:   Next enabled both routers simultaneously and tried to webpack-bundle the

254:   Vite pages' `*.test.jsx` files (which import `vitest`), causing a hard

255:   build failure (`node:module` unhandled scheme error via

256:   `vite/dist/node/module-runner.js`). Renaming avoids the collision

257:   entirely. This does touch Vite source, but only a folder name + import

258:   paths — Vite/React Router attach no special meaning to a folder named

259:   "pages", so there's no behavior change, confirmed by `npm run build` and

260:   `npm run test` both still passing after the rename. Considered safer

261:   than trying to suppress Next's directory auto-detection, which isn't

262:   configurable.

263: - Used `next.config.mjs` instead of `next.config.ts`: the `.ts` config

264:   variant failed to load (`Cannot read properties of undefined (reading

265:   'fileExists')` from Next's internal TS transpilation), a known class of

266:   issue unrelated to our code. Switching to plain `.mjs` sidesteps it

267:   entirely and we don't need TS-specific config typing yet.

268: - Added `outputFileTracingRoot` pinned to the project directory in

269:   `next.config.mjs`, because Next.js was misdetecting the workspace root

270:   due to an unrelated stray `package-lock.json` in the user's home

271:   directory (outside this repo). Harmless either way, but keeps file

272:   tracing correctly scoped.

273: - Set `eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds: true` in `next.config.mjs` for now —

274:   the existing `eslint.config.js` is a Vite-oriented flat config without

275:   the `next/core-web-vitals` plugin; wiring a proper combined ESLint setup

276:   is deferred to a later phase rather than blocking the Fase 1 build.

277: - Pinned `typescript@^5` explicitly as a devDependency after `npm install`

278:   initially pulled in a TypeScript 7 prerelease that Next.js 15 doesn't

279:   support yet ("TypeScript 7.0.2 is not supported by this version of

280:   Next.js").

281: - Note for later: `create_directory` and `copy_path` tools were both

282:   non-functional in this environment for this repo (consistently returned

283:   "outside the project" / similar errors even for root-level test paths);

284:   worked around using `write_file` (which creates the file but not missing

285:   parent dirs) plus plain shell `mkdir -p`/`mv` via the terminal tool.

286: - **Tokens via CSS `@theme`, not `tailwind.config.ts`.** The playbook's

287:   wording ("tambahkan ke tailwind.config.ts") assumes Tailwind v3-style JS

288:   config, but this project is already on Tailwind v4

289:   (`@tailwindcss/postcss`, `@import 'tailwindcss'` in CSS — set up before

290:   this rework started). v4's idiomatic, first-class way to extend the

291:   theme is a CSS `@theme {}` block, which is what generates the utility

292:   classes directly (confirmed `bg-comet`, `text-void`, etc. in the

293:   compiled output). A `tailwind.config.ts` would have been redundant/inert

294:   for this purpose under v4, so skipped it rather than add a file that

295:   does nothing.

296: - **`next/font/google` instead of `next/font/local`** for Press Start 2P /

297:   Nunito / VT323. Both approaches self-host (no runtime request to

298:   Google's CDN, which is the actual goal behind the playbook's wording);

299:   `next/font/local` would additionally require sourcing and committing the

300:   actual `.woff2` files ourselves with correct licensing, which is extra

301:   manual work for the same runtime outcome. Reversible later if we ever

302:   need fully offline builds or a font not on Google Fonts.

50: ## 2. Skill tambahan yang saya rekomendasikan kamu tambahkan
51: 
52: Tidak ada di daftarmu yang secara spesifik menutup area berikut. Kalau sistem skill-mu (Antigravity atau lainnya) bisa install skill baru, ini yang paling bernilai untuk project ini — urut prioritas:
53: 
54: 1. **Next.js App Router / Server Components specialist** — migrasi Vite→Next.js punya jebakan spesifik (routing, metadata API, `next/image`, client vs server component) yang tidak dicover skill React generik.
55: 2. **Pixel-art & retro game UI specialist** — soal teknis 9-slice panel, sprite sheet, `image-rendering: pixelated`, grid pixel-perfect scaling — beda kelas dari desain frontend biasa.
56: 3. **Technical SEO / Core Web Vitals auditor** — penting karena kamu ganti brand + kemungkinan struktur URL; perlu sitemap, structured data, dan Lighthouse budget yang dijaga ketat.
57: 4. **Game-narrative copywriting** — supaya copy "quest/adventure" tidak terasa cringe atau template; ini beda skill dari desain visual.
58: 
59: Kalau tidak ada skill siap pakai untuk keempat ini, tidak masalah — instruksinya sudah saya tulis langsung di dalam prompt Fase 3–6 di bawah, jadi Zed Agent tetap bisa jalan.

63: ## 3. Design Brief — "Zenith: Warm Nebula" (tema space, dipertahankan dari identitas asli)
64: 
65: Kamu benar, saya koreksi: identitas asli Zxaviers memang **space-themed** ("Pixel-art & Space-themed UI lover", "Powered by Pixel Art & Space Vibes 🚀") — itu harus dipertahankan, bukan diganti tema gunung. Kabar baiknya, ini malah lebih pas: secara astronomi **"zenith"** adalah titik tertinggi di langit tepat di atas pengamat — jadi nama brand dan tema space nyambung secara alami, tanpa harus meniru "desa fantasi" ala Codedex. Yang saya ambil dari Codedex cuma *vibe*-nya: hangat, santai, pixel, terasa seperti sedang berpetualang — bukan palet warnanya.
66: 
67: ### Token warna — "Warm Nebula"
68: | Nama | Hex | Peran |
69: |---|---|---|
70: | Comet Orange | `#FF8B4C` | Aksen utama, CTA, ekor komet/api roket |
71: | Star Gold | `#FFC857` | Aksen sekunder, badge/XP/glow bintang |
72: | Void Indigo | `#1B1235` | Background dasar (ruang angkasa gelap) |
73: | Nebula Violet | `#3E2A63` | Layer kartu/panel — awan nebula di atas background |
74: | Star Chart Cream | `#F5E9D6` | Teks terang & panel gaya "peta bintang" kertas astronom lama |
75: | Aurora Green | `#6FCF97` | Status sukses/"level up", dipakai sangat sedikit |
76: 
77: *(Ini tetap palet gelap-hangat dengan aksen oranye-emas yang sama seperti sebelumnya — cuma pemaknaannya sekarang eksplisit ruang angkasa: nebula, komet, bintang, aurora — bukan gunung/senja.)*
78: 
79: ### Tipografi
80: - **Display/pixel** (dipakai terbatas — judul hero, label section, badge): `Press Start 2P` atau `Silkscreen`, self-hosted via `next/font/local`.
81: - **Body** (untuk keterbacaan panjang): sans hangat dan rounded — `Nunito` atau `Quicksand`, bukan pixel font, supaya paragraf tetap nyaman dibaca.
82: - **Angka/stat/tag** (Lv., XP, tech-tag): monospace ringan — `JetBrains Mono` atau `VT323` — dipakai kecil saja untuk sentuhan game tanpa merusak keterbacaan.
83: 
84: ### Layout & signature element
85: - Section bukan navbar biasa, tapi **peta bintang/navigasi (star map)**: About = *Mission Control*, Skills = *Constellation*, Projects = *Mission Log*, Experience = *Flight Path*, Contact = *Send a Transmission*. Titik-titik bintang terhubung garis putus pixel yang "tergambar" saat discroll, seperti menghubungkan rasi bintang.
86: - **Elemen signature (satu-satunya yang paling berani, sisanya tenang)**: **Constellation Skill Tree** di section Skills — tiap skill jadi bintang pixel, dikelompokkan per kategori (Web, IoT/Embedded, Tools) membentuk rasi bintang yang saling terhubung, hover/tap menampilkan tooltip "Lv." dan bintangnya menyala lebih terang. Ini menjawab "petualangan interaktif" secara nyata sekaligus tetap 100% tema space.
87: - Kartu bergaya panel HUD kokpit / peta bintang astronom: border pixel 9-slice, sudut bertakik gaya cockpit display, drop shadow keras (offset, bukan blur) — bukan `shadow-xl` blur khas Tailwind default.
88: - Hero: parallax starfield multi-layer (bintang dekat bergerak cepat, nebula jauh bergerak lambat saat scroll/mouse-move) + sprite kecil astronaut/roket pixel dengan idle-bob animation, tombol CTA bergaya tombol "launch" konsol (turun 2px + shadow snap saat diklik).
89: - Motion dipakai secukupnya: boot-sequence loading singkat bergaya "ignition/launch countdown" (±1 detik, auto-skip jika `prefers-reduced-motion`), reveal jalur rasi bintang saat scroll, idle-sprite animation di hero. Hindari animasi bertebaran di semua elemen — itu yang membuat desain terasa AI-generated.

262: ## Small decisions made along the way (not pre-specified in §0.1)

263: 

264: - Reused `https://github.com/Zxaviers/zenith.git` (no `-portfolio` suffix)

265:   since the name was available.

266: - Keeping Vite's existing npm scripts as the "live" ones until Next.js is

267:   proven out, adding parallel `*:next` scripts instead of overwriting —

268:   most reversible option, avoids any window where `npm run dev`/`build`

269:   breaks for whoever might deploy from this branch mid-migration.

270: - **Renamed `src/pages/` → `src/views/`** (and updated the 5 imports in

271:   `src/App.jsx`). Root cause: Next.js auto-detects `src/pages` as a Pages

272:   Router directory whenever a `src/` folder exists at the project root,

273:   regardless of intent — it doesn't require a `src/app` sibling to trigger

274:   that check. With our new root-level `app/` *and* the old `src/pages`,

275:   Next enabled both routers simultaneously and tried to webpack-bundle the

276:   Vite pages' `*.test.jsx` files (which import `vitest`), causing a hard

277:   build failure (`node:module` unhandled scheme error via

278:   `vite/dist/node/module-runner.js`). Renaming avoids the collision

279:   entirely. This does touch Vite source, but only a folder name + import

280:   paths — Vite/React Router attach no special meaning to a folder named

281:   "pages", so there's no behavior change, confirmed by `npm run build` and

282:   `npm run test` both still passing after the rename. Considered safer

283:   than trying to suppress Next's directory auto-detection, which isn't

284:   configurable.

285: - Used `next.config.mjs` instead of `next.config.ts`: the `.ts` config

286:   variant failed to load (`Cannot read properties of undefined (reading

287:   'fileExists')` from Next's internal TS transpilation), a known class of

288:   issue unrelated to our code. Switching to plain `.mjs` sidesteps it

289:   entirely and we don't need TS-specific config typing yet.

290: - Added `outputFileTracingRoot` pinned to the project directory in

291:   `next.config.mjs`, because Next.js was misdetecting the workspace root

292:   due to an unrelated stray `package-lock.json` in the user's home

293:   directory (outside this repo). Harmless either way, but keeps file

294:   tracing correctly scoped.

295: - Set `eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds: true` in `next.config.mjs` for now —

296:   the existing `eslint.config.js` is a Vite-oriented flat config without

297:   the `next/core-web-vitals` plugin; wiring a proper combined ESLint setup

298:   is deferred to a later phase rather than blocking the Fase 1 build.

299: - Pinned `typescript@^5` explicitly as a devDependency after `npm install`

300:   initially pulled in a TypeScript 7 prerelease that Next.js 15 doesn't

301:   support yet ("TypeScript 7.0.2 is not supported by this version of

302:   Next.js").

303: - Note for later: `create_directory` and `copy_path` tools were both

304:   non-functional in this environment for this repo (consistently returned

305:   "outside the project" / similar errors even for root-level test paths);

306:   worked around using `write_file` (which creates the file but not missing

307:   parent dirs) plus plain shell `mkdir -p`/`mv` via the terminal tool.

308: - **Tokens via CSS `@theme`, not `tailwind.config.ts`.** The playbook's

309:   wording ("tambahkan ke tailwind.config.ts") assumes Tailwind v3-style JS

310:   config, but this project is already on Tailwind v4

311:   (`@tailwindcss/postcss`, `@import 'tailwindcss'` in CSS — set up before

312:   this rework started). v4's idiomatic, first-class way to extend the

313:   theme is a CSS `@theme {}` block, which is what generates the utility

314:   classes directly (confirmed `bg-comet`, `text-void`, etc. in the

315:   compiled output). A `tailwind.config.ts` would have been redundant/inert

316:   for this purpose under v4, so skipped it rather than add a file that

317:   does nothing.

318: - **`next/font/google` instead of `next/font/local`** for Press Start 2P /

319:   Nunito / VT323. Both approaches self-host (no runtime request to

320:   Google's CDN, which is the actual goal behind the playbook's wording);

321:   `next/font/local` would additionally require sourcing and committing the

322:   actual `.woff2` files ourselves with correct licensing, which is extra

323:   manual work for the same runtime outcome. Reversible later if we ever

324:   need fully offline builds or a font not on Google Fonts.

<USER_REQUEST>
Design a visual style for "Zenith" — a personal portfolio site. Mood: warm,

relaxed, playful interactive adventure with a space/cosmos theme — retro

pixel-art game aesthetic (think a cozy 8-bit space RPG, not a cold sterile

sci-fi dashboard). Reference feel: codedex.io's warmth and game-like

interactivity, but with a night-sky/nebula palette instead of a daytime

fantasy village.



Color palette (use these exact hex values, not close approximations):

- Background base: #1B1235 (deep space void)

- Panel/card background: #3E2A63 (nebula violet)

- Primary accent: #FF8B4C (comet orange) — used for CTAs and highlights

- Secondary accent: #FFC857 (star gold) — used for badges, glow, active states

- Light text/panel: #F5E9D6 (star-chart cream)

- Success/status accent: #6FCF97 (aurora green), used sparingly



Typography: a pixel/8-bit display font for headlines and short labels ONLY

(this font must never be used for paragraph text — it's illegible at length),

paired with a warm, rounded, highly readable sans-serif for all body copy.



Hard rule, non-negotiable: EVERY button and interactive element must have

text that is clearly readable against its own background — dark text

(#1B1235) on bright/light button fills, light text (#F5E9D6) on dark

button fills. Never generate a button with missing, invisible, or

low-contrast text.



Background starfield: organic, irregularly scattered stars of varying size

and brightness, NOT a uniform repeating tile/grid pattern — it should look

like a real night sky, not wallpaper.
</USER_REQUEST>

16px\n  md: 24px\n  lg: 40px\n  xl: 64px\n  gutter: 24px\n  margin-mobile: 16px\n  margin-desktop: 48px\n---\n\n## Brand & Style\n\nThe design system is a nostalgic tribute to 8-bit space exploration RPGs, blending a \"low-fidelity\" retro aesthetic with modern usability. It targets a creative, tech-savvy audience that appreciates a sense of wonder, playfulness, and digital craftsmanship.\n\nThe visual style is **Retro-Futuristic Brutalism**. It utilizes heavy, deliberate borders, pixelated corner geometry, and a high-contrast color palette to simulate an old-school gaming terminal. Despite the blocky structures, the interface feels \"cozy\" rather than harsh, achieved through warm lighting effects, rounded body typography, and organic starfield textures. The emotional goal is to make the user feel like an explorer navigating a personalized star-chart.\n\n## Colors\n\nThe palette is driven by the contrast between the deep \"void\" of space and the vibrant energy of celestial bodies. \n\n- **Primary (Comet Orange):** Reserved for the most important interactive elements and primary calls to action. It should vibrate against the deep purple background.\n- **Secondary (Star Gold):** Used for badges, rewards, achievements, and secondary highlights. It provides a \"glow\" effect when used in small doses.\n- **Tertiary (Aurora Green):** Dedicated to success states, completed quests, or \"online\" indicators.\n- **Surface (Nebula Violet):** Defines the \"hardware\" of the UI—panels, containers, and card backgrounds.\n- **Text (Star-chart Cream):** A warm, off-white that reduces eye strain in dark environments and maintains the \"vintage paper\" feel of old game manuals.\n\n## Typography\n\nThe typography system creates a hierarchy between \"The System\" and \"The Narrative.\"\n\n- **Headlines:** Use **Anybody** with high weights. While the request specified 8-bit styles, we use high-weight, condensed variable fonts to simulate the \"impact\" of retro display types while ensuring modern accessibility.\n- **Body Copy:** **Nunito Sans** provides a friendly, rounded counterpoint to the rigid grid. It ensures that long-form project descriptions remain legible and warm.\n- **Labels & Mono:** **JetBrains Mono** is utilized for technical metadata, navigation, and button labels to reinforce the \"coded\" nature of the 8-bit aesthetic.\n\n*Implementation Note:* For a true 8-bit feel, use `text-transform: uppercase` on all small labels and navigation items.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\n\nThis design system uses a **Rigid Pixel Grid** model. All spacing values must be multiples of 4px or 8px to maintain alignment with the \"stepped\" pixel aesthetic of the borders.\n\n- **Grid:** A 12-column fluid grid for desktop with 24px gutters.\n- **Outer Margins:** Use 48px margins on desktop to create a \"contained terminal\" look. On mobile, reduce to 16px to maximize screen real estate for content.\n- **Rhythm:** Use \"md\" (24px) for most vertical gaps between related items, and \"xl\" (64px) to separate major sections of the portfolio.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\n\nDepth in this system is achieved through **Stacking and Inner Glows** rather than realistic drop shadows.\n\n- **The Void:** The background layer is the deepest level, featuring a fixed-position organic starfield texture.\n- **Panels:** Surface levels use `#3E2A63` with a heavy 4px solid border in Star-chart Cream.\n- **Active State Elevation:** Instead of lifting an element with a shadow, interactive elements use a \"Hard Shadow\" (no blur) of 4px or 8px, using the Primary or Secondary colors to create a neon offset effect.\n- **Glassmorphism (Minimal):** Use only for floating navigation bars or overlays, with a 12px blur and 40% opacity on the Surface color.\n\n## Shapes\n\nThe design system rejects standard curves. To simulate \"8-bit roundedness,\" we use a **Stepped Corner** technique.\n\n- **Borders:** All containers must have a minimum 4px solid border. \n- **Corners:** Use CSS `clip-path` or custom SVG masks to create \"notched\" or \"pixelated\" corners (knocking out a 4x4 or 8x8 pixel square from each corner). \n- **Buttons:** Rectangular with hard edges. When hovered, the corners can \"invert\" or expand to indicate focus.\n\n## Components\n\n### Buttons\n- **Primary:** Comet Orange fill with Deep Space Void text. 4px hard-shadow offset in Star Gold.\n- **Secondary:** Transparent fill, 4px Star-chart Cream border, Star-chart Cream text.\n- **Interaction:** On hover, the button should shift 4px down and 4px right to \"cover\" its shadow, simulating a physical mechanical press.\n\n### Cards & Panels\n- **Project Card:** Surface Nebula background, 4px border. Header area should have a distinct \"title bar\" aesthetic with a solid fill background and Cream text.\n- **Badges/Chips:** Small rectangular blocks with Star Gold background and Void text. No rounded corners.\n\n### Input Fields\n- Deep Space Void background with a 2px Star-chart Cream border. \n- Focus state: Border changes to Comet Orange with a subtle outer glow (2px spread, no blur).\n\n### Lists\n- Use a custom \"Bullet\" icon: a 4px x 4px Star Gold square.\n- List items should be separated by a 2px dotted line in Nebula Violet.\n\n### Interactive Adventure Elements\n- **Progress Bar:** A \"segmented\" bar where each 10% is represented by a discrete block, mimicking an XP bar in an RPG.\n- **Tooltips:** Use the \"Pixel\" corner logic with a 100% opaque Surface Nebula Every element should feel like a physical component of a starship's navigation console, using chunky pixelated edges and vibrant light-source shadows to create depth.\n\n## Colors\nThis design system utilizes a high-contrast dark mode palette inspired by long-exposure nebula photography.\n\n- **Primary (Comet Orange):** Reserved for critical actions, key navigation links, and primary buttons. It represents the heat of propulsion and energy.\n- **Secondary (Star Gold):** Used for highlighting \"legendary\" items, hard shadows, and decorative accents. It provides the \"warmth\" in the system.\n- **Tertiary (Aurora Green):** Used for success states, health bars, and active system indicators.\n- **Surface (Deep Space Void):** The foundation for all screens. It is a deep, desaturated purple that provides more depth than pure black.\n- **Surface-Container (Nebula Violet):** Used for HUD panels, cards, and modal backgrounds.\n- **On-Surface (Star-chart Cream):** A warm off-white used for all readable text to reduce eye strain against the dark background.\n\n## Typography\nThe typography uses a high-contrast pairing to balance retro charm with modern readability.\n\n- **Headlines:** Use `anybody` with high weight and tight tracking. While not a literal pixel font, its blocky, variable nature allows for a \"modern-pixel\" look that is far more legible for portfolio content.\n- **Body:** Use `plusJakartaSans` for all long-form text. Its soft, rounded terminals provide the \"cozy\" balance to the hard-edged UI.\n- **Technical/UI Labels:** Use `spaceMono` for buttons, data readouts, and navigation tabs to reinforce the \"terminal\" or \"console\" theme.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\nThe layout follows a **HUD-inspired grid**. Every element is aligned to a 4px baseline, reflecting the \"pixel\" nature of the design.\n\n- **Grid Model:** A 12-column fixed grid on desktop, collapsing to a single-column fluid layout on mobile.\n- **HUD Panels:** Content is grouped into \"Panels\" with distinct borders. Panels should feel like modules that can be slotted into a dashboard.\n- **Spacing Rhythm:** Use multiples of 8px for internal padding (8, 16, 24, 32). Gutters are consistently 24px to give the chunky borders room to breathe.\n- **Mobile Adaptation:** On mobile, margins reduce to 16px. Borders should remain 4px thick to maintain the \"chunky\" aesthetic even at smaller scales.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\nElevation is achieved through **Hard Shadows** and **Glows** rather than soft blurs.\n\n- **Hard Shadows:** All interactive elements and primary panels use a 4px offset shadow (down and right) in `Star Gold`. Every element should feel like a physical component of a starship's navigation console, using chunky pixelated edges and vibrant light-source shadows to create depth.\n\n## Colors\nThis design system utilizes a high-contrast dark mode palette inspired by long-exposure nebula photography.\n\n- **Primary (Comet Orange):** Reserved for critical actions, key navigation links, and primary buttons. It represents the heat of propulsion and energy.\n- **Secondary (Star Gold):** Used for highlighting \"legendary\" items, hard shadows, and decorative accents. It provides the \"warmth\" in the system.\n- **Tertiary (Aurora Green):** Used for success states, health bars, and active system indicators.\n- **Surface (Deep Space Void):** The foundation for all screens. It is a deep, desaturated purple that provides more depth than pure black.\n- **Surface-Container (Nebula Violet):** Used for HUD panels, cards, and modal backgrounds.\n- **On-Surface (Star-chart Cream):** A warm off-white used for all readable text to reduce eye strain against the dark background.\n\n## Typography\nThe typography uses a high-contrast pairing to balance retro charm with modern readability.\n\n- **Headlines:** Use `anybody` with high weight and tight tracking. Every element is aligned to a 4px baseline, reflecting the \"pixel\" nature of the design.\n\n- **Grid Model:** A 12-column fixed grid on desktop, collapsing to a single-column fluid layout on mobile.\n- **HUD Panels:** Content is grouped into \"Panels\" with distinct borders. Panels should feel like modules that can be slotted into a dashboard.\n- **Spacing Rhythm:** Use multiples of 8px for internal padding (8, 16, 24, 32). Gutters are consistently 24px to give the chunky borders room to breathe.\n- **Mobile Adaptation:** On mobile, margins reduce to 16px. Components like cards should have internal padding of at least `stack-md`.\n- **Reflow:** On mobile devices, margins reduce to `16px` and headlines scale down significantly to avoid awkward line breaks in the uppercase display text.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\nElevation in this design system is achieved through **Hard Offsets** rather than light-source shadows. \n\n- **Level 1 (Default):** No shadow, just a 2px border in `Star-Chart Cream`.\n- **Level 2 (Active/Hover):** A 4px horizontal and 4px vertical offset (4px 4px 0px 0px) using the `Surface-Container` or a darker tint of the background.\n- **Tonal Layering:** To represent a hierarchy of information (e.g., a modal on top of a page), use solid color blocks of `Nebula Violet` with a thick `Comet Orange` border. \n- **No Blurs:** Gaussian blurs, soft shadows, and gradients are strictly prohibited to maintain the retro fidelity.\n\n## Shapes\nTo honor the 8-bit aesthetic, the design system utilizes **minimal roundedness**. \n\n- **Primary Radius:** Set at 4px. # 🌟 Zenith — Constellation Skills Section (Google Stitch)

Desain **"Constellation" Skills Section** untuk **Zenith** telah diperbarui secara menyeluruh menggunakan protokol **Google Stitch** dan langsung aktif di codebase:

---

### 1. 🧭 Pengelompokan Kategori (*Category Grouping*)
Keahlian dikelompokkan secara terstruktur ke dalam 3 sistem sektor kosmis:
- **🌐 Web Development:** React, Tailwind CSS, Laravel, Firebase.
- **⚙️ IoT & Embedded:** C/C++, ESP32, Sensors (ADS1115/MPU6050), Arduino.
- **🧰 Tools & Workflow:** Git & GitHub, Linux/CLI, Photoshop, Blender.

---

### 2. ☀️ Skala Ukuran Node Bintang & Intensitas Cahaya (*Level Scaling*)
Ukuran node bintang dan intensitas pancaran aura korona berpendar (*glow*) diskalakan secara otomatis berdasarkan tingkat penguasaan teknis:

| Tingkat Keahlian | Diameter Node | Intensitas & Karakter Glow (*Box Shadow*) | Status Visual |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **Proficient** | **`28px`** | **`0 0 16px 4px #ffc857, 0 0 28px 8px #ff8b4c`** | Bintang emas terbesar dengan korona pendaran hangat paling terang |
| **Familiar** | **`20px`** | **`0 0 10px 2px #ffc857, 0 0 18px 4px #ffc857`** | Bintang emas ukuran sedang dengan pendaran stabil |
| **Basic** | **`14px`** | **`0 0 6px 1px #f5e9d6, 0 0 12px 2px #f5e9d6`** | Bintang krem halus ukuran kompak untuk keahlian fundamental |

---

### 3. 🏷️ Label Ganda di Bawah Bintang (*Name & Level Underneath*)
Di bawah setiap node bintang kini tertera dua baris label terstruktur:
1. **Nama Keahlian:** Ditampilkan dengan ikon piksel (misal: `⚛️ React`, `🤖 ESP32`, `🛠️ Git & GitHub`) dalam kontras tinggi.
2. **Badge Level:** Ditampilkan tepat di bawah nama dengan warna indikator status:
   - **`[Proficient]`** ➔ Aksen **Aurora Green (`#6FCF97`)**
   - **`[Familiar]`** ➔ Aksen **Star Gold (`#FFC857`)**
   - **`[Basic]`** ➔ Aksen **Star-Chart Cream (`#F5E9D6`)**

---

### 4. 📐 Garis Asterisma Konstelasi & Radar HUD
- Node bintang di setiap grup dihubungkan dengan **garis putus-putus (*dashed lines*)** berbasis SVG membentuk geometri rasi bintang.
- Saat salah satu bintang disorot (*hover/click*), seluruh garis konstelasi yang terhubung akan menyala terang dengan filter *neon glow*.
- Panel kanan menampilkan **10-Segment Discrete LED Power Meter** dan telemetri koordinat observatorium astronomis.

---

Desain komponen kartu proyek untuk seksi **"Mission Log"** telah disesuaikan dengan arsitektur **Pixel-Art Panel Bordered Frame** (bukan kartu modern rounded generik) dan telah aktif di production:

---

### 1. 🔲 Bordered Pixel-Art Frame (Anti-Generic)
- **Bingkai Fisik Retro:** Panel menggunakan latar `#3E2A63` (Nebula Violet) dengan bingkai solid ganda 2–4px `#FFC857` (Star Gold), pencahayaan sudut atas (`.glint-top`), dan **hard offset shadow 4px** (`shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]`).
- **Telemetry Preview Window:** Jendela *viewport* artefak di bagian atas dengan badge sensor aktif `LIVE // TELEMETRY` berkedip hijau aurora (`#6FCF97`).

### 🎨 2. Rincian Perubahan di Setiap Bagian Website

#### A. Navigation Bar (Game HUD Console)
- **Desain Kokpit Fisik:** Mengubah navbar teks transparan biasa menjadi panel HUD konsol game dengan bayangan offset fisik 6px (`#0f0a20`), garis aksen pencahayaan atas (`.glint-top`), dan efek kaca *scanline*.
- **Live Status Chip:** Menambahkan badge telemetri `[SYS_OK // LIVE]` dengan lampu indikator hijau aurora berkedip di samping logo `"Zenith"`.
- **Daftar Menu Sesuai Spesifikasi:** Tersedia 7 tautan navigasi (`Home`, `Mission Control`, `Constellation`, `Flight Path`, `Mission Log`, `Send a Transmission`, `Devlog`).

#### B. Hero Section (Cohesive Celestial Scene)
- **Menghilangkan Kesan "Stiker Terpisah":** Roket dan planet tidak lagi melayang terisolasi. Ditambahkan pendaran nebula atmosferik (`#3E2A63` violet dan `#FF8B4C` orange blur 100–130px) serta lintasan vektor orbit astronomis SVG yang merekatkan seluruh adegan menjadi satu kesatuan kosmis.
- **Tipografi Terstruktur:** 
  - Headline `Hello, I'm Zxaviers` dirender pada satu baris penuh font display 8-bit tanpa terpotong (*no truncation*).
  - Subtitle `Web Enthusiast` dalam font rounded sans-serif yang ramah di mata.
- **Single Primary CTA Button:** `"🚀 Launch into Mission Log"` dengan kontras tinggi (Comet Orange `#FF8B4C` + teks hitam pekat `#1B1235` + bayangan fisik 4px Star Gold `#FFC857`).

#### C. Constellation (Skills Section)
- **Node Size & Glow Scaling:** Ukuran dan pendaran aura node bintang kini otomatis membesar dan berpendar lebih terang sesuai tingkat kemahiran:
  - **Proficient:** Diameter 28px dengan korona pendaran emas intensif (`#FFC857` + `#FF8B4C`).
  - **Familiar:** Diameter 20px dengan pendaran sedang.
  - **Basic:** Diameter 14px untuk keahlian fundamental.
- **Label Ganda di Bawah Node:** Setiap bintang memiliki nama keahlian dan badge level terpisah di bawahnya (`[Proficient]`, `[Familiar]`, `[Basic]`).
- **Garis Asterisma Berpendar:** Garis putus-putus (*dashed SVG*) otomatis menyala neon terang saat node di-hover/diklik.
- **10-Segment Discrete LED Power Meter:** Panel telemetri samping menampilkan bar LED diskrit yang menyala bertingkat seperti indikator daya game RPG retro.

#### D. Mission Log (Project Cards)
- **Bordered Pixel-Art Frame:** Mengganti kartu rounded Tailwind biasa dengan panel berpola pixel-art berbingkai solid ganda 2–4px dan bayangan offset tajam 4px (`shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_#000]`).
- **Telemetry Viewport Window:** Setiap kartu memiliki jendela pratinjau dengan badge sensor `LIVE // TELEMETRY`.
- **Tech-Stack Tags Berketerbacaan Tinggi:** Tag teknologi (React, Tailwind, ESP32, dll.) berlatar gelap `#1B1235` dengan teks emas `#FFC857` yang tajam dan tidak kabur.
- **Dua Tombol Aksi Taktil:**
  1. **`🚀 Live Demo`** (Isian Comet Orange `#FF8B4C` dengan teks gelap `#1B1235` untuk membuka demo live).
  2. **`⚡ Repo`** (*Ghost panel* berbingkai Star Gold untuk membuka repository code).
  3. **`[ Inspect Full Case Study → ]`** untuk navigasi ke rincian studi kasus mendalam.

#### E. Core Design System & CSS Utilities (`globals.css`)
- Ditambahkan utilitas visual Stitch:
  - `.glint-top` (garis highlight pencahayaan panel).
  - `.segment-bar`, `.segment-filled`, `.segment-empty` (LED status bar).
  - `.hud-scanline` (tekstur CRT retro).
  - `.animate-nebula-pulse` (animasi bernapas lembut pada nebula latar belakang).

1: ---
2: name: managing-python-dependencies
3: description: |
4:   Ensures proper Python dependency management, avoiding global `pip install` and
5:   adhering to project-specific tooling.
6: 
7:   Use this skill if any of the following are true:
8:     1. Attempting to run `pip install {package_name}`.
9:     2. Python packages or dependencies need to be added or modified.
10:     3. Initiating a new Python project.
11:     4. Creating a new notebook, even if just using BigQuery cells.
12:     5. Generating Python code that includes `import` statements for third-party libraries.
13:     6. Before executing Python scripts via the terminal to ensure the correct virtual environment is active.
14: license: Apache-2.0
15: metadata:
16:   version: v1
17:   publisher: google
18: ---
19: 
20: # Python Dependency Management Rule
21: 
22: > [!CAUTION]
23: >
24: > **BEFORE any `pip install`**: You MUST first detect the project's existing
25: > dependency manager and use it correctly. Do NOT override the project's
26: > established tooling.
27: 
28: ## Dependency Manager Detection
29: 
30: Before installing ANY Python package, check the workspace for these files **in
31: priority order**:
32: 
33: 1.  **Signal:** `uv.lock` or `pyproject.toml` with `[tool.uv]`
34:     *   **Tool:** **uv**
35:     *   **Install:** `uv add <package>`
36:     *   **Setup:** `uv sync`
37: 2.  **Signal:** `pyproject.toml` with `[tool.poetry]`
38:     *   **Tool:** **Poetry**
39:     *   **Install:** `poetry add <package>`
40:     *   **Setup:** `poetry install`
41: 3.  **Signal:** `Pipfile`
42:     *   **Tool:** **Pipenv**
43:     *   **Install:** `pipenv install <package>`
44:     *   **Setup:** `pipenv install`
45: 4.  **Signal:** `environment.yml`
46:     *   **Tool:** **Conda**
47:     *   **Install:** `conda install <package>`
48:     *   **Setup:** `conda env create -f environment.yml`
49: 5.  **Signal:** `requirements.txt` only
50:     *   **Tool:** **venv + pip**
51:     *   **Install:** `.venv/bin/pip install <package>`
52:     *   **Setup:** `.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt`
53: 6.  **Signal:** None of the above
54:     *   **Tool:** **venv + pip** (default)
55:     *   **Install:** `.venv/bin/pip install <package>`
56:     *   **Setup:** `.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt`
57: 
58: ## Default: venv + pip
59: 
60: If no dependency manager is detected, use **venv + pip + requirements.txt** as
61: the default:
62: 
63: ```bash
64: # Initialize environment
65: python3 -m venv .venv
66: 
67: # Add dependencies
68: .venv/bin/pip install <package>
69: 
70: # Preserve state
71: .venv/bin/pip freeze > requirements.txt
72: ```
73: 
74: **Rules for venv + pip workflow:**
75: 
76: -   Always use `.venv/bin/pip` or `.venv/bin/python` (explicit path).
77: -   After installing, run: `.venv/bin/pip freeze > requirements.txt`.
78: -   When setting up: `.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt`.
79: 
80: ## Prohibited
81: 
82: -   **NEVER** run `pip install` globally
83: -   **NEVER** override an existing dependency manager with a different one
84:

1: # 🗺️ Zenith Rework — Master Playbook untuk Zed Agent

2: 

3: > Peran saya di sini: **mind master** yang menyusun brief + prompt. Eksekusi teknis (edit file, install package, commit) dilakukan oleh Agent Panel di Zed. Tempel tiap blok "PROMPT UNTUK ZED" secara berurutan, review diff-nya, baru lanjut ke fase berikutnya — jangan tempel semua sekaligus, karena migrasi Vite→Next.js + rebranding + reskin sekaligus terlalu besar untuk satu pass agent yang reliable.

4: 

5: **Catatan soal daftar skill yang kamu lampirkan:** itu terbaca seperti katalog skill gaya *Google Antigravity*, bukan sistem skill Zed. Zed Agent tidak "memanggil" skill dengan nama seperti itu — dia hanya membaca instruksi di prompt/context yang kamu berikan. Jadi saya sudah **menenun keahlian dari skill-skill yang relevan langsung ke dalam prompt di bawah**, supaya tetap jalan di Zed tanpa bergantung pada sistem skill itu. Kalau ternyata kamu *juga* punya skill/rules file custom di dalam project untuk Zed (`.rules`, `AGENTS.md`, dst), sebut nama skill relevan (`claude-frontend-design`, `impeccable`, `framer-motion-expert`, `a11y-auditor`, `stitch-google`, `react-performance-optimizer`, `vercel-v0`) di awal prompt supaya agent Zed ikut membacanya sebagai konteks tambahan.

Artinya stack saat ini **Vite + React + Tailwind**, dideploy lewat GitHub Actions (kemungkinan besar ke GitHub Pages).

14: - ⚠️ **Perhatian penting**: nama repo `Zxaviers/Zxaviers` (sama dengan username) itu repo spesial GitHub — isinya otomatis tampil di halaman profil `github.com/Zxaviers`. 50: ## 2. Skill tambahan yang saya rekomendasikan kamu tambahkan

51: 

52: Tidak ada di daftarmu yang secara spesifik menutup area berikut. Kalau sistem skill-mu (Antigravity atau lainnya) bisa install skill baru, ini yang paling bernilai untuk project ini — urut prioritas:

54: 1. **Next.js App Router / Server Components specialist** — migrasi Vite→Next.js punya jebakan spesifik (routing, metadata API, `next/image`, client vs server component) yang tidak dicover skill React generik.

55: 2. **Pixel-art & retro game UI specialist** — soal teknis 9-slice panel, sprite sheet, `image-rendering: pixelated`, grid pixel-perfect scaling — beda kelas dari desain frontend biasa.

56: 3. **Technical SEO / Core Web Vitals auditor** — penting karena kamu ganti brand + kemungkinan struktur URL; perlu sitemap, structured data, dan Lighthouse budget yang dijaga ketat.

63: ## 3. Design Brief — "Zenith: Warm Nebula" (tema space, dipertahankan dari identitas asli)

64: 

65: Kamu benar, saya koreksi: identitas asli Zxaviers memang **space-themed** ("Pixel-art & Space-themed UI lover", "Powered by Pixel Art & Space Vibes 🚀") — itu harus dipertahankan, bukan diganti tema gunung. Kabar baiknya, ini malah lebih pas: secara astronomi **"zenith"** adalah titik tertinggi di langit tepat di atas pengamat — jadi nama brand dan tema space nyambung secara alami, tanpa harus meniru "desa fantasi" ala Codedex. Yang saya ambil dari Codedex cuma *vibe*-nya: hangat, santai, pixel, terasa seperti sedang berpetualang — bukan palet warnanya.

66: 

67: ### Token warna — "Warm Nebula"

68: | Nama | Hex | Peran |

69: |---|---|---|

70: | Comet Orange | `#FF8B4C` | Aksen utama, CTA, ekor komet/api roket |

71: | Star Gold | `#FFC857` | Aksen sekunder, badge/XP/glow bintang |

72: | Void Indigo | `#1B1235` | Background dasar (ruang angkasa gelap) |

73: | Nebula Violet | `#3E2A63` | Layer kartu/panel — awan nebula di atas background |

74: | Star Chart Cream | `#F5E9D6` | Teks terang & panel gaya "peta bintang" kertas astronom lama |

75: | Aurora Green | `#6FCF97` | Status sukses/"level up", dipakai sangat sedikit |

76: 

77: *(Ini tetap palet gelap-hangat dengan aksen oranye-emas yang sama seperti sebelumnya — cuma pemaknaannya sekarang eksplisit ruang angkasa: nebula, komet, bintang, aurora — bukan gunung/senja.)*

78: 

79: ### Tipografi

80: - **Display/pixel** (dipakai terbatas — judul hero, label section, badge): `Press Start 2P` atau `Silkscreen`, self-hosted via `next/font/local`.

81: - **Body** (untuk keterbacaan panjang): sans hangat dan rounded — `Nunito` atau `Quicksand`, bukan pixel font, supaya paragraf tetap nyaman dibaca.

82: - **Angka/stat/tag** (Lv., XP, tech-tag): monospace ringan — `JetBrains Mono` atau `VT323` — dipakai kecil saja untuk sentuhan game tanpa merusak keterbacaan.

83: 

84: ### Layout & signature element

85: - Section bukan navbar biasa, tapi **peta bintang/navigasi (star map)**: About = *Mission Control*, Skills = *Constellation*, Projects = *Mission Log*, Experience = *Flight Path*, Contact = *Send a Transmission*. 86: - **Elemen signature (satu-satunya yang paling berani, sisanya tenang)**: **Constellation Skill Tree** di section Skills — tiap skill jadi bintang pixel, dikelompokkan per kategori (Web, IoT/Embedded, Tools) membentuk rasi bintang yang saling terhubung, hover/tap menampilkan tooltip "Lv." dan bintangnya menyala lebih terang. Ini menjawab "petualangan interaktif" secara nyata sekaligus tetap 100% tema space.

87: - Kartu bergaya panel HUD kokpit / peta bintang astronom: border pixel 9-slice, sudut bertakik gaya cockpit display, drop shadow keras (offset, bukan blur) — bukan `shadow-xl` blur khas Tailwind default.

88: - Hero: parallax starfield multi-layer (bintang dekat bergerak cepat, nebula jauh bergerak lambat saat scroll/mouse-move) + sprite kecil astronaut/roket pixel dengan idle-bob animation, tombol CTA bergaya tombol "launch" konsol (turun 2px + shadow snap saat diklik).

89: - Motion dipakai secukupnya: boot-sequence loading singkat bergaya "ignition/launch countdown" (±1 detik, auto-skip jika `prefers-reduced-motion`), reveal jalur rasi bintang saat scroll, idle-sprite animation di hero. Hindari animasi bertebaran di semua elemen — itu yang membuat desain terasa AI-generated.

Sekarang, kami telah melakukan **Major Visual Overhaul & Interactive RPG Upgrade** secara menyeluruh di seluruh halaman portofolio Zenith:

---

### 🚀 Rekap Upgrade Visual & Fitur Baru yang Telah Diterapkan:

#### 1. 🌌 Hero Section — Cockpit Adventure Command Station
- **RPG Pilot Telemetry Bar:** Status pilot taktil `OPERATOR // ZXAVIERS` | `MISSION // ZENITH` | `SYS_INTEGRITY: 100% NOMINAL` dengan lampu indikator hijau aurora berdenyut.
- **RPG Quick-Stat HUD:** Menampilkan panel mini 3 kolom:
  - `CLASS:` **SYSTEM ENG**
  - `SECTOR FOCUS:` **IoT & WEB**
  - `CURRENT EXP:` **LV. 20 // 94%**
- **Volumetric Atmospheric Glow:** Latar belakang awan nebula berlapis dengan jalur orbit vektor SVG bercahaya, merekatkan roket dan planet ke dalam satu adegan kosmis yang utuh.
- **Dua Tombol Konsol Taktil:**
  - `🚀 Launch into Mission Log` (Comet Orange dengan bayangan emas fisik 4px).
  - `📡 Send a Transmission` (Ghost Gold Panel).

#### 2. 🕹️ Mission Control — 8-Bit RPG Cutscene Terminal
- **Speaker Portrait Frame Berpendar:** Foto profil pilot/HQ dalam bingkai emas 8-bit tebal dengan status sensor aktif.
- **Audio Waveform Visualizer:** Equalizer bar audio live (`LIVE COM`) yang bergerak dinamis merefleksikan frekuensi transmisi radio (`FREQ 142.85 MHz`).
- **Interactive Cutscene Controls:** Dilengkapi tombol `← Prev`, `Next Transmission →`, dan indikator stepper horizontal untuk membaca dialog HQ ↔ Zxaviers layaknya game petualangan RPG.

#### 3. 🌟 Constellation — Interactive Astronomical Observatory
- **Level-Scaled Stars & Glow:** Bintang membesar dan berpendar otomatis sesuai tingkat keahlian (*Proficient 28px*, *Familiar 20px*, *Basic 14px*).
- **Dual Label Terstruktur:** Setiap node bintang memiliki label nama keahlian dan badge level di bawahnya.
- **Dynamic Glowing Asterisms:** Garis rasi bintang menyala terang saat node disorot/diklik.
- **10-Segment Discrete LED Power Meter:** Menampilkan bar LED daya diskrit bertingkat di panel samping.

#### 4. 🔲 Mission Log — Sci-Fi Quest Data Cartridges
- **Bordered Pixel-Art Frame:** Bingkai berbingkai ganda retro dengan bayangan offset keras 4px.
- **High-Contrast Tech Chips:** Tag teknologi berlatar gelap pekat `#1B1235` dengan teks emas `#FFC857` berdaya baca tinggi.
- **Dua Tombol Aksi Fisik:** `🚀 Live Demo` dan `⚡ Repo` untuk setiap artefak proyek.

#### 5. 🛰️ Flight Path & Footer — Orbital Trajectory Station
- **Vertical Trajectory Rail:** Lintasan penerbangan dengan node bintang di setiap tonggak pencapaian (*Waypoint WP-01 s/d WP-03*).
- **Unlocked Achievement Medals:** Kartu penghargaan hologram (*Honor Roll*, *IoT Builder*, *Web Shipper*, dll.).
- **Upgraded Orbital Footer:** Dilengkapi link profil sosial media (*GitHub, LinkedIn, Instagram*) serta tombol download CV penerbangan (*Download Flight CV*).

lg: 48px\n  xl: 80px\n  gutter: 24px\n  margin-mobile: 16px\n  margin-desktop: 64px\n---\n\n## Brand & Style\nThe design system centers on a \"Cozy 8-bit Space RPG\" aesthetic, blending the nostalgia of vintage hardware with the warmth of a modern, relaxed adventure. The style is **Retro-Futuristic Brutalism**—it utilizes chunky, intentional \"unrefined\" geometries, heavy offset shadows, and pixel-inspired motifs to create a tactile, hardware-like interface.\n\nThe brand personality is adventurous yet comforting. It avoids the coldness of traditional sci-fi in favor of a \"lived-in\" spacecraft feel. Visuals should prioritize high-contrast readability, playful movement (subtle floating animations), and a distinct \"physical\" presence for every UI element.\n\n## Colors\nThe palette mimics a star-chart viewed through a warm lens. \n- **Deep Space Void (#1B1235):** The primary canvas color. It is not pure black, but a deeply saturated purple-tinted void.\n- **Nebula Violet (#3E2A63):** Used for containers, panels, and secondary structural elements.\n- **Comet Orange (#FF8B4C):** The high-energy primary action color. Use for call-to-actions and critical focus states.\n- **Star Gold (#FFC857):** Reserved for highlights, ratings, and rare discoveries.\n- **Star-Chart Cream (#F5E9D6):** The primary text and iconography color to ensure maximum legibility against dark backgrounds.\n- **Aurora Green (#6FCF97):** Indicative of successful \"docking\" or completed missions.\n\n## Typography\nThe typography system balances character with utility:\n- **Display & Headlines:** Use **Anybody** for a variable, bold look. It should feel impactful and slightly compressed, reminiscent of vintage game title screens.\n- **Body Text:** Use **Nunito Sans** for its friendly, rounded terminals that soften the \"hard\" pixel edges of the containers. \n- **System Labels:** Use **Space Mono** (as a substitute for pixel mono where accessibility is required) for all technical data, terminal readouts, and small metadata.\n\n**Special Treatment:** Headlines should occasionally use `text-shadow` in Comet Orange or Star Gold to simulate glowing CRT phosphors.\n\n## Layout & Spacing\nThe layout follows a **8px grid system** (2x the 4px shadow unit) to ensure all elements align to a \"pixel-perfect\" cadence. \n\n- **Grid Model:** A 12-column fluid grid for desktop with 24px gutters. For mobile, a 4-column grid with 16px margins.\n- **Rhythm:** Spacing should be generous (\"Cozy\") rather than cramped. \n- **Alignment:** Content should feel anchored. Avoid floating elements without a defined container. Containers should \"snap\" to the grid.\n\n## Elevation & Depth\nIn this design system, depth is not conveyed through blurs or light sources, but through **Hard Offset Shadows**. \n\n- **Level 1 (Base):** Deep Space Void background.\n- **Level 2 (Panels):** Nebula Violet surfaces with a 4px solid shadow (offset 4px right, 4px down) in `#000000` or a darker shade of Void.\n- **Level 3 (Interactive):** Comet Orange or Cream surfaces with a 6px or 8px solid shadow to indicate \"hover\" or \"active\" states.\n\n**Textures:** All primary panels should feature a subtle 2px horizontal \"scanline\" overlay at 5% opacity to reinforce the CRT hardware aesthetic.\n\n## Shapes\nThe shape language is strictly **Geometric and Notched**. While the base roundedness is `0` (Sharp), the \"Rounded 8-bit\" look is achieved through:\n- **Corner Notches:** Instead of radii, use 8px diagonal clips (notches) on the top-right and bottom-left corners of primary panels.\n- **Pixel Borders:** Use 4px solid borders.\n- **Dividers:** Use dashed lines (e.g., 4px dash, 4px gap) to mimic technical schematics.\n\n## Components\n- **Buttons:** Large, rectangular with 4px borders. Primary buttons use Comet Orange with Star-Chart Cream text. On hover, the button shifts its position -2px X and -2px Y while the shadow grows, creating a \"lifting\" effect.\n- **Cards:** Nebula Violet background, 4px solid Star-Chart Cream border, and a \"Header Bar\" using a contrasting color. Add a \"Blinking Cursor\" icon in the bottom right of active cards.\n- **Input Fields:** Recessed look created by inverting the shadow (inner shadow style). Use Space Mono for input text.\n- **Chips/Badges:** Small, pill-like shapes but with sharp 45-degree angled ends rather than curves.\n- **Progress Bars:** Segmented blocks (increments of 10%) rather than a smooth continuous fill, evoking retro loading sequences.\n- **Dialogs:** Modal windows must feature \"Corner Brackets\" (L-shaped decorative lines) on all four corners to frame the Avoid floating elements without a defined container. ### 🕹️ 2. Arsitektur Komponen Rework Penuh (Kode Nyata)

#### 🎮 A. Cockpit Game HUD Navigation Bar (`Navbar.tsx`)
- Logo **Zenith** di sudut kiri atas dengan chip status **`[SYS_OK // LIVE]`** berdenyut hijau aurora (`#6FCF97`).
- Bingkai konsol taktil bergaris aksen emas (`.glint-top`) dengan 7 tautan navigasi (`Home`, `Mission Control`, `Constellation`, `Flight Path`, `Mission Log`, `Send a Transmission`, `Devlog`).

#### 🌌 B. Hero Section — Cozy Space RPG Adventure Command
- **Atmosfer Nebula Berlapis:** Awan kosmis volumetrik `#3E2A63` violet dan `#FF8B4C` orange dengan jalur orbit vektor SVG yang merekatkan seluruh ilustrasi roket dan planet.
- **Pilot Telemetry Bar:** Status HUD `OPERATOR // ZXAVIERS` | `MISSION // ZENITH` | `SYS_INTEGRITY: 100% NOMINAL`.
- **RPG Quick-Stat Panel:**
  - `CLASS:` **SYSTEM ENG**
  - `SECTOR FOCUS:` **IoT & WEB**
  - `CURRENT EXP:` **LV. 20 // 94%**
- **Headline & Primary Button:** `"Hello, I'm Zxaviers"` (1 baris penuh, tidak terpotong) + tombol taktil `"🚀 Launch into Mission Log"` (Comet Orange dengan bayangan emas 4px).

#### 📻 C. Mission Control — 8-Bit RPG Cutscene Terminal
- Bingkai foto pilot Zxaviers dan HQ dalam bezel emas retro berkedip sensor.
- **Live Audio Frequency Waveform Visualizer:** Equalizer audio yang bergerak dinamis merefleksikan transmisi radio (`LIVE COM` `FREQ 142.85 MHz`).
- Dialog interaktif `← Prev` dan `Next Transmission →` dengan indikator stepper transcript.

#### 🌟 D. Constellation — Interactive Astronomical Observatory
- **Star Scaling:** Node bintang membesar dan berpendar otomatis sesuai tingkat kemahiran (**Proficient 28px**, **Familiar 20px**, **Basic 14px**).
- **Dual Labeling:** Nama keahlian dan badge level tertera jelas di bawah setiap bintang.
- **Glowing Asterism Lines:** Garis rasi bintang menyala terang saat disorot.
- **10-Segment Discrete LED Power Meter:** Bar LED daya diskrit bertingkat di panel samping.

#### 🔲 E. Mission Log — Sci-Fi Quest Data Cartridges
- Bingkai panel pixel-art retro dengan hard shadow offset 4px dan aksen pencahayaan atas (`.glint-top`).
- Tech-stack chips berlatar gelap pekat `#1B1235` dengan teks emas `#FFC857` berdaya baca tinggi.
- **Dua Tombol Aksi Fisik:** `🚀 Live Demo` dan `⚡ Repo` untuk setiap artefak proyek.

#### 🛰️ F. Flight Path & Orbital Footer
- Lintasan trajektori vertikal dengan waypoint berkilau (`WP-01`, `WP-02`, `WP-03`).
- Matrix badge penghargaan hologram (`Honor Roll`, `IoT Builder`, `Web Shipper`, dll.).
- Footer dengan channel sosial media (`GitHub`, `LinkedIn`, `Instagram`) dan tombol download CV penerbangan.

### 🚀 Transformasi Layout & Desain Baru (Full Rework):

3. **🕹️ Retro-Brutalist 4px/6px Hard Offset Shadows (`.rpg-shadow` & `.rpg-shadow-hover`):**
   - Menggantikan rounded card standar dengan bingkai fisik tebal bersudut tegas, bayangan solid `#000000`, dan efek tombol fisik yang tertekan ke dalam bayangannya saat di-klik (*tactile hardware feel*).

4. **👾 Arcade Cabinet Marquee (`SecretLevel.tsx`):**

5. **🌟 Constellation Observatory & Mission Log Data Cartridges:**
